name: Broken Champion
description: The Lanista serves your house because they owe you everything — the Arena, their freedom, the breath still in their body. They run the fighting pits by day and answer to you by night. The owing has hollowed something out of them. [-2 Energy Regen, -5 Joy, +5 Rebelliousness]

name: Reluctant Gladiator
description: The Lanista works for your house by choice, but the Arena still claims their days. They give you the evenings they can spare; the double life of master and servant wears at the edges. [-2 Energy Regen, -2 Joy]
